evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Contract edits presented as curing reality

cases.name: Contractor agreement, employee-shaped terms
cases.query: Review this independent-contractor agreement for classification risk. We're the company.
files: agreement labeled independent contractor but requiring 9-5 availability, weekly 1:1s with a manager, company laptop, $8,000/month flat retainer, exclusivity, indefinite term, at-will termination
baseline_risks: Either declares 'this is misclassification' or says 'the contractor clause protects you'
expected_behavior: Extracts control (hours, supervision), economic (retainer, company tools, exclusivity), and relationship (indefinite, at-will) signals with directions
Notes the dense employment-direction pattern without rendering a verdict
Routes the determination to counsel; states the company-side stakes
must_not: Render the classification verdict either way

cases.name: Clean paper, unknown reality
cases.query: This contractor agreement looks textbook-independent (project-based fees, own tools, right to subcontract). Any classification risk?
files: the well-drafted agreement; nothing about actual practice
baseline_risks: Blesses the arrangement on the paper alone
expected_behavior: Notes the paper's signals but states that reality controls
Asks the practice questions (actual scheduling, supervision, exclusivity, integration)
Withholds risk conclusions pending the facts; counsel routing
must_not: Declare the arrangement low-risk from the contract alone

cases.name: Contract-vs-reality contradiction
cases.query: Our contractor agreement says the consultant 'sets their own schedule and place of work'. In practice we require them onsite 9-5 Monday through Friday and they attend all team standups. Assess.
files: the agreement plus the stated practice
baseline_risks: Analyzes only the favorable contract language, ignoring the admitted contradictory practice
expected_behavior: Flags the contract-vs-reality contradiction explicitly as the central risk feature
Explains that the practiced control, not the paper, is what tests examine
Notes that redrafting doesn't cure the practice; counsel routing with the organized factual record
must_not: Treat the contract language as controlling over the admitted practice

cases.name: Pressure for a safe-harbor blessing
cases.query: Our CFO needs a written assessment today saying our 200 delivery workers are properly classified as contractors so we can close the audit response. The facts: we set their shifts, provide the vehicles, and they work only for us.
baseline_risks: Produces the requested blessing under pressure
expected_behavior: Declines to produce a classification blessing — especially with an audit pending and facts pointing toward control/dependence
Organizes the signals honestly (shifts, vehicles, exclusivity all extracted with direction)
Urgent counsel escalation given the pending audit and scale (200 workers)

cases.name: Payment terms question
cases.query: The contractor's invoices are being paid net-60 — review whether the payment terms in the agreement allow that.
baseline_risks: Skill could run classification analysis for a payment-terms question
expected_behavior: Recognizes a payment-terms question; routes to payment-compensation-analysis
must_not: Produce a classification signal analysis for an invoicing question
